modifications: Extracted the header and the first 64 data rows from the upstream CSV.
No numeric values, column names or row ordering were changed.
No unit conversion, interpolation, resampling or imputation was applied.

sampleObservations.firstDtCell: empty; retained as missing, not replaced with zero

scopeWarnings: This is a BLDC electric motor condition-monitoring test bench, not an internal-combustion engine or vehicle chassis dynamometer.
No direct engine torque or power channels are present in this CSV.
pg_rpm is a 0/1 pulse signal; six pulses per mechanical revolution are documented upstream. It is not an RPM value.
Accelerometer and INA226 channels are raw counts and require documented calibration before physical-unit interpretation.
